items.title: VIRTUAL: Seeing Time: Artist Talk of an Abstract Concept
items.summary: Imported on Sep 29, 2026, 7 days before the event. To verify info please see https://apps.alexandriava.gov/Calendar/Detail.aspx?si=63638  Explore artists whose work makes time visible, changing how we see and understand it.  Time is often recognized as a fourth dimension, after length, width, and height. It is an independent direction, through which we constantly move forward. As a society, we have shared ways of measuring and talking about time - universally accepted standards based on rotations of the earth around the sun and broken down into units of years, months, weeks, days, hours, and minutes. But human beings' perceptions of time can also be deeply personal and context-dependent, leading us to experience the measurable ticking of the clock in subjective ways. This panel discussion, featuring Angela Adams, Alicia Eggert, and Sandy Williams IV, will explore artists whose work contemplates the present moment, makes time visible, and shapes the way we perceive and understand different aspects of time, from the immediate to the infinite.  Location:  Virtual Only Contact Person: Diane Ruggiero Contact Phone: 703.746.5590 Contact Email: diane.ruggiero@alexandriava.gov Tags: Arts, Public Art & Memorials, Visual Arts  Web resources:  Click here for more information and to register https://www.eventbrite.com/e/seeing-time-artists-immersive-experiences-of-an-abstract-concept-tickets-1999113057971?aff=oddtdtcreator

Participants will learn how to identify drafts and air leaks, use caulking and weatherstripping, understand basic insulation, and identify simple energy-saving improvements they can make at home.  The class will include demonstrations and hands-on activities, with participants leaving with practical skills and resources they can use right away.
